newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound o/n rates widen, one week up.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound o/n rates widen, one week up.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound widened in a "neutral" private-sector market on Sunday to between 7-3/4 and nine percent from eight and 8-3/4 percent on Thursday, bankers said.
"The market is neutral. There is supply, there is demand," one banker said.
One-week rates rose to between 8-1/2 and nine percent from eight to 8-1/2 percent on Thursday, the bankers said.
Bankers said that public-sector banks kept their official minimum lending rate steady at 10-1/2 percent.
